Discord trên máy tính hoặc trình duyệt:: Discord on desktop or in a browser: right-click an emoji or sticker in a message → Copy Link.

Trên điện thoại: giữ vào emoji → mở tran: On a phone: press and hold the emoji → open its info; if there is no copy button, use Discord in a browser.

Emoji tải dạng WEBP (giữ ảnh động, không: Emoji download as WEBP (animation kept, lossless); stickers keep Discord's original file: PNG, animated PNG (APNG), GIF or Lottie (.json, for developers).
Emoji tĩnh, sticker tĩnh thành PNG; emoj: Still emoji and stickers become PNG; animated ones (APNG, Lottie) become GIF. GIF pixels are either fully transparent or not, so edges can look jagged: pick a White or Black background to match where you paste.
